method.overview: Personally viewed 28 six-page JPEG montages (the last contains 3 pages), 1800×3900 pixels, approximately 890×1260 per source page. All 165 pages were observed to inventory layout and figures; this does not certify dense text or every chart number.
method.detail: Personally viewed 31 selected individual pages rendered at a 1700-pixel long side. Cross-checked extracted layout text. The detailed notes identify the reviewed topics; they do not certify every numeric, legal or technical statement.
method.handoff: KM had viewed pages 1–24. This reviewer revisited them and viewed all remaining pages. The count is 165 unique pages, not 189.

lessonOmissions.title: SSOP document-control header and form-reading
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson lists operational SSOP fields and effectiveness/reproducibility checks; activity identifies vague instructions.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: Creation/revision date and drafting/approval ownership in the source sample header are not explicitly taught; no supplied example form is interpreted.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add a fresh original small SSOP form and identify revision/approval fields; keep chemical/time values explicitly fictional and independently checked.

lessonOmissions.title: Complete observation-record interpretation
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson distinguishes actual from planned time and requires measured value/criterion/person/action; records/review responsibilities are discussed.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: A form-reading exercise joining planned/actual time, equipment ID, decision, recorder, independent review and receipt/issue/action remarks is absent; general request to compare needed fields is not a worked record.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add an original filled/partly incomplete log-reading activity; do not reuse source0–3°Cas a general setting.

lessonOmissions.title: Branched flow diagram and CCP/zone reading
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson teaches input/output, returned materials and on-site confirmation; activity draws its own simple process.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: No supplied branched flow diagram demonstrates tracing packaging/water/ingredients across zones and locating contextualCCPs; current generic diagram-making does not demonstrate interpretation of such branches.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Create independent simplified flow with new product/process labels and contextualCCPs, then trace branches and confirm on-site checks.

lessonOmissions.title: Explicit OL label and complete paired-limit reading
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson distinguishes permissible limit and earlier-action operational criteria and mentions precision/calibration/proxy evidence.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: OL acronym/name and a complete paired numerical CL/OL interpretation exercise are absent from the36lessons; only the conceptual distinction is present.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add fictional labeledCL/OLexample and ask which earlier action trigger applies; preserve target,time,inequalities,measurement precision and workplace terminology caveat.

lessonOmissions.title: Random sampling and1σ/2σ curve interpretation
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson defines population,sampling,bias,range,σ and approximately99.7percent at±3σ.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: Random sampling/random-number selection is not named or demonstrated;±1σ68.3percent and±2σ95.4percent and their positions on the curve are not taught in the lessons. Tests may contain them; this is lesson-only scope.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add an original normal curve and biased-vs-random sample exercise; state normality/stability assumptions and avoid a universal percentage claim.

lessonOmissions.title: Histogram construction and explicit shape discrimination
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson names all6histogram types and warns to examine bins,measurement and mixed populations; teaches general role.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: No worked classification/shape-reading visual, bin-frequency construction or decimal boundary assignment explains why binning can produce gaps; source provides these details.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Use fresh small measurements to form bins and classify original shape examples; keep cause hypotheses tentative.

lessonOmissions.title: Control-chart example patterns beyond limits/trend
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson names limits,bias and rising trends and tells workers to confirm workplace criteria.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: Specific source example patterns,including alternating runs,near-center clustering and avoidance of center,are absent; no plotted series is classified.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add original small plots covering pattern families with a labeled exercise-specific rule table, rather than presenting sourceJIScounts as universal factory settings.

lessonOmissions.title: Graph-axis and check-sheet/fishbone interpretation
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson explains graph purposes and includes a genuine freshPareto-drawing exercise with48/80/100percent cumulative ratios.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: No supplied chart-reading examples test left/rightParetoaxes,composition-band versusradaraxes,tally-to-total interpretation or placement of result versus candidate causes on fishbone. ExistingParetopractice must not be described as absent.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add original compact charts/tally/fishbone and axis/branch questions, without reproducing source artwork.

lessonOmissions.title: Time-weighted multi-period operating speed
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson correctly defines planned-time utilization and constant-speed productivity product and distinguishes human-work evaluation.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: No changing-speed multi-period example shows time-weighted mean performance and reconciliation to total output/plannedoutput. Simple averaging of percentage speeds is not addressed.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add independently consistent fictional two-period example; computeΣ(speed×actualtime)/Σactualtime then totaloutput/plannedoutput, avoiding source88.7roundingtypo.

lessonOmissions.title: Value-added meaning and factory indicator units
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson mentions total output,labor input and value-added as possible indicators and teaches physical productivity/resource-unit arithmetic.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: Value-added is named but not defined or calculated. Factory-level monetary indicators per time/per laborinput and indirect-department context are not developed.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Define fresh example value-added and explicit monetary/time/labor-input units; separate this from physicalkg/hproductivity.

lessonOmissions.title: Risk-matrix lookup and action-priority table
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson correctly teaches4assessmentsteps,sample-specificscales and controlhierarchy; activity compares controls.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: No worked lookup demonstrates likelihood/severity categories through a provided matrix to priority/actions; stopping/escalation interpretation of the sample priority rows is not practiced.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add fictional clearly labeled matrix and urgent/medium/lowactiontable, explicitly exercise-only; preserve mandatorylegalrequirements and avoid scoremultiplicationassumptions.

lessonOmissions.title: Management-system scope distinctions
lessonOmissions.existingCoverage: Lesson namesISO9001/14001/22000,FSSC22000,SQF,JFS-C and distinguishes certification from law.
lessonOmissions.missingOrInsufficientLessonContent: The namedISOstandard scopes—quality,environment,food safety—and differences betweenmanagement-systemstandard andcertificationscheme are not explained beyond names.
lessonOmissions.safeNextStep: Add concise scope-matching instruction grounded in the edition,then require current company-certificationscope confirmation; no newcurrentlegalclaims.

sourceDiscrepanciesReconfirmedOrFound.finding: Aggregate23.8gfor18000items inconsistent with10000×25.5gand8000×24.0g; weightedmean24.833333g. Existinglesson020usesfreshconsistentdata; do notcopy sourceaggregate.

PDF 110 / printed 101 gives 350 ÷ 395 = 88.7%. Exact division gives 88.6075949367%, which rounds to 88.6% at one decimal place. Lesson food-2-027 uses a fresh 210 ÷ 240 = 87.5% example; no lesson correction is needed.

existingCoreCoverageConfirmed: Lesson 031 already teaches the four KYT rounds and team action target.
Lesson 033 already teaches the control hierarchy and mandatory legal requirements; the remaining gap is matrix/priority interpretation practice.
Lesson 019 already provides trace-back/forward and an actual-lot exercise.
Lesson 021 already includes a fresh Pareto construction and cumulative-percentage exercise; chart practice is partial, not absent.
Lesson 020 uses fresh, internally consistent average/range data rather than the source weighted-mean error.
Validation versus verification, and correction versus root-cause corrective action, are already distinguished.
limitations: Completing the visual inventory does not certify full semantic coverage or professional/native review.
Only 31 pages received individual detailed review. Other figures, such as organizational roles, the historical harassment chart and the SDGs grid, received overview review.
The lesson gaps do not establish absence from tests, 1号 lessons or other app content.
This pass did not fully decompose or map all 104 level-2 TOC units; competency certification flags must remain unchanged.
No UI/device validation or authored assets. No repository or Git writes.
